title: Discover Seville on two wheels
text: A really beautiful and interesting bike tour through Seville! We did the tour in English with Cristina. The communication was very pleasant and uncomplicated from the beginning. Cristina explained everything clearly and in an interesting and entertaining way, so that we were able to learn a lot about the city. The visited places and neighborhoods were varied, beautiful, and truly worth seeing. A great way to get to know Seville by bike. Absolutely recommended!
author: Nomad07794224374

title: Beautiful experience
text: Beautiful ride! Silvio is very professional and very kind!
author: -vero-34250

title: A very nice and interesting bike tour
text: We booked the private tour (in English) at the last minute, and that was the best decision we could have made. If you only spend a few days in the city, this is a quick way to see all the beautiful sights of the city. Our tour guide, Cristina, was extremely friendly and entertaining, and you can tell that she is very knowledgeable about history and loves her job. The bikes were brand new and very comfortable; they were easy to adjust to the height of each participant. I can recommend this tour 100%. Thank you!
author: irenebX4342YX

title: Amazing bike tour
text:
Cody took us out just the 2 of us on a last minute booking. He set up his business last year. He was a very patient and informative guide. We were offered e bikes but were happy with standard. Bikes appeared new, well maintained , and easy to ride. Helmets , water bottle and knapsack included. We covered a lot at a very gentle pace with time for photos and rest stops. He was very knowledgeable about his home city and really made it a very enjoyable 3 hrs.
HIGHLY RECOMMEND
author: mayg132

title: Amazing experience!
text: I had a private tour with Cristina. She was really nice and made the experience very enjoyable. It was a lovely way to explore the city. Definitely recommend it!
author: susanalB6950TL

title: Superb discovery of Seville by bike.
text:
We chose a private bike tour of Seville and we will have an excellent memory of it. Superb way, accessible to all, to discover this beautiful Andalusian city.
Thanks to our guide who knew how to share their knowledge and love of their city with us. Clear explanations and anecdotes made this outing exciting. Everything was perfect and we also got plenty of tips for discovering the rest of the city and good addresses for typical restaurants. We recommend this experience and our guide Silvio.
author: Pioneer10711704554

title: Beautiful bike experience with sylvio
text:
Sylvio is a very interesting guide and shares his passion for his city through history and anecdotes.
Very thoughtful and attentive to his group
author: O6488WEvivianel

title: We recommend
text: We loved visiting Seville by bike. It was a first for us. The city is equipped with bike paths, which allows for safe exploration. Our guide, who is also one of the founders, is passionate about history and very attentive to clients. Since we knew some places, he adapted the route to help us discover other locations.
author: 863catherinet

title: Discover Seville by bike
text: A top-notch guided bike tour of Seville! Our guide Silvio spoke excellent French and shared his love for his city with us! A very comprehensive tour of Seville! Do it without hesitation!
author: palounoel

title: Great quality and friendly bike tour
text: A great time in the company of Sylvio. Very warm welcome, we were even upgraded to an electric bike for free. Very good explanations of the history of Seville and the main monuments. Small group and a very friendly and high-quality exchange with Sylvio. We left with a small backpack as a gift and plenty of recommendations for other things to visit as well as all the good typical things to drink and eat in Seville.
